capabilities.publicKnowledge: read versioned public JSON branches through the parent manifest
capabilities.taskContext: receive a scoped task packet from the primary core
capabilities.branchLoading: load branches lazily according to the active task
capabilities.handoff: return structured findings, evidence references, proposed actions and uncertainty

capabilities.connected: use connected services only when the active task needs them and the host grants access
